repo_notes.content: Generate separate, fully localized en and zh wikis. The English titles and parent names in pages are canonical outline identifiers, not text to copy into every locale. For en, write all user-facing titles, navigation, headings, summaries, diagrams, and prose in English. For zh / zh-CN / zh-Hans, translate them consistently into Simplified Chinese. Use these six Chinese top-level titles, in order: 入门指南, 核心 TLS 模块, 抓取模式, 进阶使用, 架构与探针开发, 构建、测试与发布. Translate Other Modules as 其他模块. Preserve product names, CLI flags, API paths, code identifiers, and standard technical terms such as TLS, eBPF, text, keylog, and pcapng. Check every generated page for wrong-language titles or prose.

Create exactly the six top-level sections in pages, with no extra top-level section. The first four sections contain 21 user-facing pages; the last two contain 9 developer-facing pages. Aim for about 70% of total explanatory content for users and 30% for developers, not just the page-count ratio. User pages explain selection, prerequisites, runnable workflows, expected output, interpretation, and troubleshooting. Developer pages explain architecture, event ABI, lifecycle, output routing, builds, tests, and extension. Keep NSS/NSPR, Bash, Zsh, MySQL/MariaDB, and PostgreSQL only in the single Other Modules page under Advanced Usage. Give no non-core probe its own page or chapter elsewhere.

The core of this wiki is tls (OpenSSL/BoringSSL), gotls, and gnutls. Spend most user-facing space on using these three commands and choosing among text, keylog, and pcapng. Each core module and each mode needs verified commands, required target or interface setup, expected artifact, a way to confirm success, and relevant limitations. Explain that text shows captured plaintext events, keylog provides TLS secrets for a separate packet capture, and pcapng contains packet blocks plus an embedded TLS Decryption Secrets Block. Do not imply keylog alone contains packets or pcapng is only a keylog file.

Verify facts against current source code, README, docs/agent/architecture.md, and docs/agent/output-pipeline.md. For tls, gotls, and gnutls, -m selects text, keylog, or pcap/pcapng representation; --eventaddr selects the primary captured-event destination; --logaddr carries operational logs only. Explain the legacy --keylogfile and --pcapfile aliases and mode-specific destination and rotation rules accurately. Do not invent commands, supported versions, or performance numbers. Do not put source-file links or code citations in summaries or user-facing explanatory text. Mermaid labels must describe concepts, not file paths or Markdown links.
